name: BF4 Warning Menopause
head: Check your towel tonight
text:
Before you oil your scalp tonight, put a white towel on your shoulders.

Menopause changed my hair. Thinner at the part, drier, a texture I didn't recognise. So I started oiling my scalp at night. The dropper is why I kept quitting.

When I finally did the towel test, my part was barely damp, my fingers were slick and the towel was soaked. The oil was going everywhere except my scalp.

Ninu puts it on the part. Hollow silicone tips, one hand, about two minutes. Works with the oil you own.

It can't promise what your hair does. It makes sure the oil gets there.
